# Generated by "Claude files/tools/build_ship_metallurgy.py". Re-run it instead of editing this file.
# Ironclad (Man of War) class of the metallurgy designer. The shared effects are called with DA_unit = SHIP.

# Unlocks the class. Safe to call twice: a second call changes nothing.
DA_enable_Metal_Ship = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_enable_metallurgy_System_ship } }
		set_country_flag = DA_enable_metallurgy_System_ship
		DA_initialize_metallurgy_variables = { DA_unit = SHIP }
		hidden_effect = { DA_pre_apply_metallurgy_modifiers_SHIP = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_modifier = DA_metal_ship_country_enabler } }
		add_country_modifier = { name = DA_metal_ship_country_enabler duration = -1 }
	}
}

# A blueprint option. Same parameters as DA_apply_Blueprint, shown in ship words. No rune slots.
DA_apply_Blueprint_SHIP = {
	custom_tooltip = DA_Blueprint_preview_tooltip
	custom_tooltip = DA_Cost.tt.$DA_Cost$
	custom_tooltip = DA_SHIP_power.tt.$DA_power$
	custom_tooltip = DA_SHIP_fire.tt.$DA_fire$
	custom_tooltip = DA_SHIP_shock.tt.$DA_shock$
	custom_tooltip = DA_SHIP_Fire_rec.tt.$DA_Fire_rec$
	custom_tooltip = DA_SHIP_Shock_rec.tt.$DA_Shock_rec$
	custom_tooltip = DA_Blueprint_preview_tooltip_after
	hidden_effect = {
		DA_apply_Blueprint = {
			DA_unit = SHIP
			DA_Cost = $DA_Cost$
			DA_RUNE_SLOTS = 0
			DA_power = $DA_power$
			DA_fire = $DA_fire$
			DA_shock = $DA_shock$
			DA_Fire_rec = $DA_Fire_rec$
			DA_Shock_rec = $DA_Shock_rec$
		}
	}
}

# The totals as shown numbers. Durability is the fire-damage-received total with its sign turned.
DA_pre_apply_metallurgy_modifiers_SHIP = {
	DA_pre_apply_metallurgy_modifiers = { DA_unit = SHIP }
	set_variable = { which = DA_durability_TOTAL_SHIP_shower which = DA_Fire_rec_TOTAL_SHIP_shower }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_durability_TOTAL_SHIP_shower value = -1 }
}

# The five total lines of a design, for tooltips.
DA_show_SHIP_preview_tooltips = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_power_TOTAL_SHIP_shower value = 0.01 } }
		custom_tooltip = DA_TOTAL_PREVIEW.DA_power.SHIP.tt
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_power_TOTAL_SHIP_shower value = 0 } } }
		custom_tooltip = DA_TOTAL_PREVIEW.DA_power.SHIP.tt-
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_fire_TOTAL_SHIP_shower value = 0.01 } }
		custom_tooltip = DA_TOTAL_PREVIEW.DA_fire.SHIP.tt

		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_fire_TOTAL_SHIP_shower value = 0 } } }
